# Historical reader compatibility fixtures

These are privacy-normalized synthetic compatibility fixtures derived from
historical Artifact 1.3, 1.4 and 1.5 data, not byte-identical historical scientific
observations. Fictitious Windows roots replace private workstation, person-folder
and interpreter installation paths. Separators, spaces, path relationships,
source populations, metrics, statuses and failure cases are preserved.

Repository-relative upstream names (including home/users directories), parser
previews, legacy format identifiers and third-party attribution remain intact.
The private original bytes and old-to-new mapping are held outside this tree.
FIXTURES.json identifies the derived bytes; it does not certify historical origin.
Missing fixtures remain failures. No signature, trust receipt or protected
approval is created by this projection.
